title: LA Colossal – Ru-Guan 03 (Standing)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Indonesian woman in her mid-30s, long dark waves, natural face with a warm smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Ru ware celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. High-gloss deep saturated duck-egg blue glaze clearly different from skin, with a fine dense crackle of thin dark lines, no painted motifs, not kintsugi. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully glazed and crackled.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, one hand lifting her hair at shoulder height, the other on her outer hip, torso turned open to the camera. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch duck-egg blue glazed platform stiletto sandals with multiple thin straps across the instep.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, pale blue.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Cool key with warm raking side light and soft rim light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
